report.name: Authorized owner initializes verified source content exactly once
Draft stays absent from the public API
Author cannot publish or edit another author’s source page
Cross-site writes and missing CSRF marker are rejected
Scheduled publication is hidden, then visible after release time
Stale writes return conflict and preserve newer version
Image bytes persist in R2 and are served with nosniff
Event publishes and exports a real ICS document
Backup export includes content, versions and media metadata
Archiving removes content; permanent deletion is separately protected
